value.rationale: The paper-motivated symmetric antiphase orbit is a natural ecological time-sharing dynamic. The nontrivial exact coupling cutoff gamma* partitions all symmetric maps into those that can and cannot exhibit an exponentially attracting exchange cycle; two exact growth endpoints determine the stability interval. This supplies a useful analytic phase diagram unavailable from mere simulation and does not rely on an unmotivated narrow instance.
